rules: This mirror is transport evidence only and cannot override private Project Control.
Only CURRENT_TASK.md grants the exact current task; RUN_QUEUE.json is backlog visibility, not blanket authority.
Candidate output authority is limited to the current task and one bounded Run.
No private source may be copied, reconstructed or exposed through this public bridge.
No secrets, production data, credentials, DB writes, migrations, merge, promotion or canonical effects.
Full source/bundles must not be emitted to HumanRoot chat.
Coder 7 emits compact design recipe only; Titi materializes real source separately and records exact authorship/provenance.
GREEN recipe completion means ready for materialization only, never Bug Gate/integration/runtime/production PASS.
